Priyom — thanks for the updated quote. We're generally aligned but have a few asks before I share with procurement:

- Term: we want to shift from a 12-month term to an 18-month term starting Jan 1 to match our product roadmap.
- Capacity: we will precommit to a +60% capacity uplift for the first 6 months (burst up to 120% in month 3).
- Legal: our counsel flagged two items in the MSA (auto-termination language and data retention specifics). They asked for a redline.

Can you send a redlined MSA/order form and a proposed execution timeline? If possible, include Exhibit A with the revised capacity schedule. Procurement wants to review by next Wed (11/21).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Alyssa

Looping in quick legal bullets after a first pass on the redline. Copying the relevant excerpt from the draft: 

--- excerpt (from Crestline_Renewal_Redline_v2.docx) ---
MSA §9 Termination: draft currently allows for immediate termination for convenience with 30-day notice AND a pro-rated credit. Crestline's counsel asked to retain a convenience termination but remove language that allows for a full refund of precommitted capacity fees.
--- end excerpt ---

Our position: we can agree to a convenience termination right but must preserve the precommit recovery mechanism (i.e., a non-refundable portion tied to reserved capacity during the committed period). Recommend replacing the refund language with a termination-liability schedule (see comment in doc).

Also: Data retention §12 — Crestline requests narrower retention windows for some logs. We can accommodate a 90-day retention for access logs but require a 12-month retention for audit logs for compliance. Please flag if Crestline's counsel insists on less than 12 months for audit logs; that will need an exception approval.

Action items for PR: please confirm the committed-dollar hold associated with the +60% uplift (Markus can confirm ops risk and commit lead time). I'll prepare clean language for the termination liability schedule and provide a tracked change in the doc.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. Derek reviewed your proposed edits and has two small asks: 
1) Move the termination-liability schedule into Exhibit C rather than embedding procedural language in §9.
2) For data retention, Crestline is willing to accept the 12-month audit log retention if we add a scoped assurance that logs used for customer analytics will be purged at 90 days; they're asking for the segregation language to be explicit.

Procurement also wants the 50% deposit callout to be described as a "Reservation Fee" in the order form. That helps their internal finance coding.

We (Crestline) reviewed Exhibit-A and have a small timing request: can you shift the month-3 burst window from day 60–90 to day 45–75 (to align with our campaign launch)? If ops can commit, we'll accept the deposit language and move to sign.

I'll be the signer for the credit card billing portion; procurement suggests DocuSign for the formal countersign. If you can send a DocuSign envelope by 11/21 EOD we can execute.
